subject.title: fix(teams-meetings): join and transcribe live meetings reliably

question: Should the published meeting-browser `permissions()` API become immediately mandatory for external plugin adapters, or should this change ship with a named compatibility/deprecation path?
rationale: The branch intentionally removes the prior call shape while expanding a plugin SDK contract; repository policy treats shipped external plugin APIs as compatibility-sensitive and requires maintainer-visible direction.

options.title: Ship a compatibility path
options.body: Keep the current call shape working during a documented deprecation window while migrating bundled and external adapters.

options.title: Approve the breaking API change
options.body: Accept the required `meetingUrl` parameter as an intentional immediate SDK break and publish explicit upgrade guidance for plugin authors.

recommendation.title: Ship a compatibility path
recommendation.body: Keep the current call shape working during a documented deprecation window while migrating bundled and external adapters.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the merged Teams and shared meeting-browser surfaces and authored this proposed SDK change.
